zatca.automatic_submission_to_zatca_is: Automatic submission to ZATCA is not running on this server
zatca.as_administrator_run_as_administ: as administrator (Run as administrator), and make sure that
zatca.in_the_env_file_until_then_send: in the .env file. Until then, send them manually from here.
zatca.used_for_0_lines_whose_item_sets: Used for 0% lines whose item sets no specific reason. It is better to set the category and reason on each item's card.
zatca.no_devices_linked_invoices_are_i: No devices linked: invoices are issued with the phase-1 QR code. Add a device and get an OTP from the Fatoora portal (fatoora.zatca.gov.sa) to enable phase 2.
zatca.a_device_specific_ecdsa_secp256k: A device-specific ECDSA (secp256k1) key is generated and stored encrypted, then a certificate request (CSR) is made in the authority's format.
zatca.integration_with_zatca_xml_signi: Integration with ZATCA — XML signing, invoice chaining, clearance and reporting

zatca.overdue_n: {n} simplified invoice(s) passed the reporting deadline (24 hours). Check the connection and resend.

hrset.changing_these_values_changes_th: Changing these values changes the calculation of payroll, insurance and end of service for new runs only. Make sure they match the social insurance circulars, the labour law and your employees' contracts.
hrset.start_of_the_new_system_new_subs: Start of the new system (new subscribers)
hrset.pension_rate_step_up_for_new_sub: Pension rate step-up for new subscribers (per party)
hrset.statutory_art_117_30_days_at_ful: Statutory (Art. 117): 30 days at full pay, 60 at three quarters, 30 unpaid.
hrset.month_s_pay_for_each_of_them: month's pay for each of them
hrset.resignation_art_85_share_of_the: Resignation (Art. 85): share of the entitlement by length of service
hrset.beyond_the_last_tier_the_full_aw: Beyond the last tier the full award is due.
hrset.their_days_are_not_deducted_from: Their days are not deducted from annual leave and no absence is recorded on them. Enter the two Eid dates in the Gregorian calendar for each year.
hrset.enable_it_only_if_your_company_s: Enable it only if your company's approved work regulations provide for it. What exceeds the monthly allowance is deducted at the per-minute rate.
hrset.printed_on_the_mudad_file_and_th: Printed on the Mudad file and the bank payroll file. The bank format is based on common templates; check the file with your bank on first upload.
hrset.establishment_number_at_the_mini: Establishment number at the Ministry of Human Resources
hrset.company_values_fields_not_custom: Company values; fields not customised follow the platform's statutory defaults
hrset.name: Name
hrset.r_annuity: Pension share included in the rates above %
hrset.statutory_colon: Statutory: {days} days, and {senior} after {years} years (Art. 109). An employee's contract may grant more than his file.
hrset.s_month_days_h: To compute the daily wage (absence, leave, end of service)
hrset.s_ot_h: A share of the basic hourly wage added to the hourly wage (Art. 107: 50%)
hrset.s_ded_h: Of the wage for advances and penalties (Art. 92: 50%)

setidx.supported_formats_png_jpg_webp_g: Supported formats: PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF (up to 3 MB).
setidx.the_logo_appears_automatically_i: The logo appears automatically in the header of printed tax invoices, thermal POS templates and quotations.
setidx.choose_the_tax_compliance_phase: Choose the tax compliance phase and manage the link with the authority's “Fatoora” platform
setidx.choose_the_phase_applied_in_your: Choose the phase applied in your company *
setidx.issue_invoices_electronically_an: Issue invoices electronically and store them with a TLV-encoded QR code generated locally, without a direct link to the authority's servers.
setidx.five_field_qr_code_compatible_wi: Five-field QR code compatible with the ZATCA app
setidx.ready_and_working_at_once_for_al: Ready and working at once for all sales and POS invoices
setidx.direct_link_with_the_fatoora_pla: Direct link with the Fatoora platform through APIs, with digital signing and encrypted certificates (CSID).
setidx.build_ubl_2_1_xml_files_and_the: Build UBL 2.1 XML files and the encrypted hash
setidx.invoicing_devices_egs_certificat: Invoicing devices (EGS), certificates, compliance checks and follow-up of clearance and reporting are managed from the e-invoicing screen. Phase 2 turns on automatically when a device is linked.
setidx.the_statutory_rate_in_the_kingdo: The statutory rate in the Kingdom. Zero-rated and exempt lines are set on the item card.
setidx.numbering_prefixes_are_set_in_th: Numbering prefixes are set in the “Numbering guide” by those who hold its permission.
setidx.message_text_for_sending_documen: Message text for sending documents to customers (email / WhatsApp)
setidx.show_the_hijri_date_umm_al_qura: Show the Hijri date (Umm al-Qura) in document PDFs
setidx.choose_the_default_accounts_in_t: Choose the default accounts in the chart to which automatic journal entries are posted when invoices, purchases or taxes are issued.
setidx.how_does_the_system_recognise_ac: How does the system recognise accounts when a custom chart is created?
setidx.the_system_links_operational_tra: The system links operational transactions (sales and purchase invoices, cash payments, bank transfers, taxes) with the accounts chosen below to create entries automatically. If an account is not chosen, it falls back on the standard account codes.
setidx.credited_as_revenue_when_any_sal: Credited as revenue when any sales invoice is issued.
setidx.receivables_customers_account_de: Receivables / customers account (debit on credit sales) *
setidx.debited_for_credit_invoices_or_r: Debited for credit invoices or remaining unpaid amounts.
setidx.purchases_cost_of_goods_sold_acc: Purchases / cost of goods sold account *
setidx.recorded_as_an_expense_or_purcha: Recorded as an expense or purchase cost when goods and materials are bought.
setidx.credited_as_a_financial_liabilit: Credited as a financial liability on credit purchase invoices.
setidx.a_liability_account_owed_to_the: A liability account owed to the authority, where the tax added to sales invoices is recorded.
setidx.a_current_asset_account_where_re: A current-asset account where recoverable purchase tax, deductible in the return, is recorded.
setidx.used_to_record_quick_cash_receip: Used to record quick cash receipts and POS (cash) invoices.
setidx.used_automatically_for_bank_tran: Used automatically for bank transfers and card payments when the cashier does not choose a bank.
setidx.the_base_currency_is_locked_to_k: The base currency is locked to keep journal entries sound, keep tax invoices consistent with ZATCA, and avoid exchange-rate conflicts.
setidx.users_in_the_chosen_roles_must_e: Users in the chosen roles must enable two-factor authentication (authenticator app) before using the system.
setidx.a_countdown_warning_appears_one: A countdown warning appears one minute before sign-out. Zero = no automatic sign-out.
setidx.print_the_receipt_automatically: Print the receipt automatically after the order
setidx.sends_the_simplified_receipt_str: Sends the simplified receipt straight to the cashier's thermal printer as soon as pay is pressed.
setidx.allow_credit_sales_at_the_cashie: Allow credit sales at the cashier
setidx.a_credit_sale_button_appears_for: A “Credit sale” button appears for a specific customer (not the cash customer) with an optional down payment; the remainder is recorded as a customer receivable and his credit limit is respected.
setidx.covers_line_discount_order_disco: Covers line discount, order discount and selling below the item price; anything above needs the “Control discounts” permission (Shifts → Manage by default).
setidx.warn_when_the_budget_is_exceeded: Warn when the budget is exceeded
setidx.block_overruns_except_for_those: Block overruns (except for those with “Override budget”)
setidx.compares_the_expense_purchase_in: Compares the expense, purchase invoice and purchase order with the approved plan from the start of the fiscal year to the document's month; accounts without a budget line are not restricted.
setidx.these_terms_appear_at_the_bottom: These terms appear at the bottom of all invoices issued to customers...
setidx.leave_empty_to_use_the_default_t: Leave empty to use the default text
setidx.choose_the_sales_account_from_th: -- Choose the sales account from the chart --
setidx.choose_the_main_cash_box_account: -- Choose the main cash box account --
setidx.cannot_change_after_invoices: Cannot change after invoices are issued. Branches in other countries are added from the Branches screen.
setidx.sets_the_company_tax_and_its: Sets the company tax and its tax number. Branches in other countries are added from the Branches screen.
setidx.logo_type_err: Please choose a valid image file (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF).
setidx.logo_size_err: The image must not exceed 3 MB.
setidx.logo_upload_err: An error occurred while uploading the logo.
setidx.logo_del_q: Are you sure you want to delete the company logo?

projshow.name: Name
projshow.billing_note: — advance ({adv}%) and retention ({ret}%) are deducted on saving.
projshow.advance_note: A tax invoice is issued for the advance (tax is due on receipt) and it is recovered from billings at {adv}%.
projshow.wip_note: The difference between earned and billed revenue ({wip}) is posted and reversed automatically the next day.
